name: Coin Block Clock
description: A tiny platformer level: the time sits in a brick block and a question block. Once a minute Mario jumps, bumps the minute block and a coin pops out. A Goomba strolls across the ground, clouds drift, steps are the coin tally and a mushroom appears next to Mario when the battery is full.

steps.script: const n = project.elements.length; for (const i of [n-3,n-2,n-1]) project.elements[i].name += ' Main'; return 1
const n = project.elements.length; for (const i of [n-3,n-2,n-1]) project.elements[i].name += ' Aod'; return 1

const a = globalThis.__a; const mkI = async (name, handle, x, y, src) => { const e = await addElement('IMG', { src }); e.name = name; e.src = src; if (handle) e.handle = handle; e.x = x; e.y = y; e.show = 'normal' }; await mkI('Goomba', 'gob', 340, 320, a[6]); return 1
const a = globalThis.__a; const e = await addElement('IMG', { src: a[0] }); e.name = 'Mario'; e.src = a[0]; e.handle = 'mar'; e.x = 259; e.y = 296; e.show = 'normal'; return 1
project.groups = project.groups || {}; for (const e of project.elements) { if (/ Aod$/.test(e.name) && e.group) project.groups[e.group] = 'Clock AOD' } return JSON.stringify(project.groups)

project.groups = project.groups || {}; project.groups.gBlocks = 'Blocks'; let n = 0; for (const nm of ["Coin","Hour block","Minute block"]) { const e = project.elements.find((x) => x.name === nm); if (e) { e.group = 'gBlocks'; n++ } } return n

project.groups = project.groups || {}; project.groups.gActors = 'Characters'; let n = 0; for (const nm of ["Goomba","Power-up","Mario"]) { const e = project.elements.find((x) => x.name === nm); if (e) { e.group = 'gActors'; n++ } } return n
